sentences.en: That's an important point, because narrowing down so-called sexy clothes means pinpointing the styles and sizes that best suit a woman's figure and personal tastes.

sentences.en: The difficulty for many women is pinpointing when these observations apply to them.

sentences.en: Because pinpointing the exact moment of ovulation is difficult, women should use other methods of checking ovulation beyond any physical signs and symptoms, especially if they are using natural family planning birth control.

sentences.en: After observing the changes for a few months, you may be able to find consistencies from one month to the next that make pinpointing ovulation possible.

sentences.en: Recognizing the first signs of labor can be challenging and many inconsistencies can make pinpointing a specific time difficult.
sentences.vi: Nhận biết những dấu hiệu chuyển dạ đầu tiên có thể là một thách thức và nhiều điểm không nhất quán có thể khiến việc xác định thời gian cụ thể trở nên khó khăn.

sentences.en: Every woman's cycle is different, so these types of calendars are helpful in pinpointing specific target conception dates, as well as teaching you how to look for and track particular physical signs of ovulation.
